blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police are investigating the discovery of an unidentified woman’s body in a vacant lot along a road in Barangay Sapul, Calapan City, early Saturday, Nov. 7. The Calapan City Police Station (CPS) said the body was discovered at 1:15 a.m. The victim was estimated to be between 20 and 30 years old. Police personnel from the station’s substation in Barangay Sta. Isabel immediately responded after receiving information about the incident. They verified the report and conducted an initial investigation at the scene. Police sought the assistance of the Scene of the Crime Operatives to process the […]...
